translations.web: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.
translations.bsb: When I heard this report, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled out some hair from my head and beard, and sat down in horror.
translations.kjv: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
